import html # Example HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the sanitized values. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on a webpage. Notes ----- * The function uses `html.escape` to neutralise special HTML characters, preventing injection attacks (CWE‑74). * No additional escaping is performed beyond this, as the output will be inserted directly into an HTML document. """ # Sanitize input to avoid injection of malicious markup safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Construct the final HTML formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_description) return formatted_post
